messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Then I started to have all these reeling thoughts in my head.

output.original_text: Then I started to have all these reeling thoughts in my head.
output.joy: Then I began to have all these exhilarating thoughts swirling in my head!
output.sadness: Then I started to have all these heavy thoughts weighing down in my head.
output.fear: Then I began to have all these terrifying thoughts racing through my mind.
output.anger: Then I started to have all these infuriating thoughts bouncing around in my head.
output.surprise: Then I suddenly found myself with all these astonishing thoughts flooding my mind!
output.disgust: Then I started to have all these revolting thoughts crawling in my head.
